title: Flights
short: Preferred fares, seats and routes arranged by your travel designer.
intro: From a quick regional hop to a long-haul business class journey, our team finds the right routing, fare and seat for you, then books it directly with the airline. Your e-tickets appear in My OneVaya the moment they are issued.

highlights.title: Every cabin
highlights.text: Economy, premium economy, business and first, on leading airlines.

highlights.title: Smart routing
highlights.text: Direct flights or well-timed connections that suit your plans.

highlights.title: Seats & extras
highlights.text: Seat selection, extra baggage, meals and special assistance.

highlights.title: Changes handled
highlights.text: Need to change a date? Request it from inside your booking.

faqs.q: Do you book flights online instantly?
faqs.a: No. Every flight is booked by a OneVaya travel designer directly with the airline, so we can advise on the best option. You receive a quote first and confirm before we book.

faqs.q: Where will I find my e-ticket?
faqs.a: Once issued, your e-ticket PDF is uploaded to your booking in My OneVaya and we also notify you by email.
